envelope.rule: Box3.intersectsBox(playerBox, crystalBox): the rider's centre within ±1.5 m of the crystal on X and on Z, feet between p.y − 1.336 m and p.y + 3.0 m (rider box 0.936 m tall). While grinding the box reaches 0.35 m below the feet, which ride 0.15 m above the rail, so a rail line between p.y − 1.486 m and p.y + 3.2 m collects.
